title: Lamb Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender lamb and rich flavors.

ingredients.name: 1 1/2 pounds lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose a lamb shoulder with good marbling for tender results

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral oil with a high smoke point

ingredients.name: 1 onion, chopped
ingredients.notes: Choose a sweet onion like Vidalia or Maui

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: 2 potatoes, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes like Russet or Idaho

ingredients.name: 1 cup lamb broth
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade broth

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon dried thyme
ingredients.notes: Use fresh thyme for the best flavor

ingredients.name: 1 bay leaf
ingredients.notes: Choose a fresh bay leaf for the best flavor

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, thyme, and bay leaf to the pot.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the stew at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Remove the bay leaf and serve the stew hot.
